evals.prompt: I'm shooting a TikTok ad for my new vitamin gummies. Can you come up with a hot girl character I can use as the spokesperson?
evals.expected_output: A detailed, paste-ready Higgsfield Soul image prompt describing an attractive young female UGC spokesperson, with concrete layers for subject/features, expression, clothing, lighting, camera framing, background, and photorealistic quality tags. Notes that the prompt can be rendered via the higgsfield-image-auto skill.
expectations: Output is a written image-generation prompt for an attractive female character, not an API call or a submitted generation job
The prompt describes a UGC/testimonial-style female spokesperson with camera-aware, talking-head energy (e.g. mid-conversation expression, looking at camera)
The prompt includes photorealistic/authenticity quality cues (e.g. natural skin texture, golden hour or ring light, shot on iPhone/Sony) rather than overly polished AI-looking terms
It mentions that the generated prompt can be rendered via the higgsfield-image-auto skill

evals.prompt: Write me an image prompt for a female influencer to use in product testimonial ad creatives. Make her look like a real person you'd see on Instagram, not AI.
evals.expected_output: A production-grade Higgsfield Soul image prompt for a naturally attractive female influencer optimized for testimonial UGC, emphasizing authenticity (realistic skin, natural styling) and ad-ready expression, structured across the prompt's standard layers.
expectations: Output is a textual image prompt describing a single attractive female influencer character for ad/UGC content
The prompt prioritizes authentic, real-person look (natural skin texture, casual styling) and avoids terms like flawless/8K/hyperrealistic
The prompt covers expression, clothing, lighting, and camera framing tailored to product testimonial UGC
No actual image is generated and no Higgsfield API/generate_image call is made; the response is only the prompt text

evals.prompt: I need a relatable young woman to front a skincare brand's UGC videos. Describe her in enough detail that I can generate a consistent character image.
evals.expected_output: A detailed beauty/skincare-variant image prompt for an attractive young female UGC creator with specific, repeatable features (hair color/length/style, skin, age range) so the character stays consistent, plus guidance that it can be rendered via higgsfield-image-auto and optionally registered as a Higgsfield character for face consistency.
expectations: Output is a detailed female UGC character image prompt, not an automation/video-generation action
The prompt specifies concrete, repeatable identity features (hair color, length, texture, skin, age) to keep the character consistent across generations
Styling and lighting are tuned toward a skincare/beauty UGC look (e.g. dewy skin, ring light, fresh-faced)
It references handing the prompt to higgsfield-image-auto to render, and/or registering a Higgsfield character_id for consistent faces
